honest_read: Closer than r1 on every round-1 design tell for this module: the leaf now reads as a ladder (two serrated rails flanking a long deep slot), the rear end is one chunky notched assembly with big side clamps, the block has a swooping S edge with a chamfer band under the leaf rising into a rounded transverse bar at the front, a prominent pin head, a slim slotted link and extra screws. A blind judge will probably still pick ours: c2 draws the sight ~1.3x taller / longer relative to the block than the side view allows (the spec's stations win), so the block still looks big and the leaf lower; the traced slanted see-through slot reads as a small crack in the shoulder band; the dust cover (smooth, no steps), the charging handle and the gas tube cap in the same crop belong to other modules; and the render is clean CG next to a worn painted drawing.
outside_this_module: recoil spring guide button + dust cover rear step: receiver_right owns them (not in c2)
c2 'lower front lug' = bolt carrier charging handle (receiver_right)
curved shell right of the pin head = gas_tube_rear_cap
